notes.title: Super Mombo Quest Live!
notes.content:
Super Mombo Quest is a fast and acrobatic platformer with lots of action, precision and a rewarding combo system for PC, mobiles and consoles! It mixes the metroidvania genre with classic arcade mechanics, featuring some crazy combats, challenging combos and plenty of collectibles - all in a huge interconnected world! 

Your objective is to save the Subrosa's lands from the evil King of Nightmares. And for that, you must explore the four corners of the map to find the big crystals that will open the portal. To help in the adventure, each crystal transforms you into a new shape with an extra ability! You can take the fire, the leaf, the rock… or even the electric form! But be careful, you will only get these crystals after facing intense battles against wicked bosses.

Make combos by defeating all of the enemies in the level while your combo bar is active. Defeat bosses, unlock upgrades and choose a Mombo form to customize your gameplay and make lots of Mombo Combos!

notes.title: A SUPER-ACROBATIC precision platformer?
notes.content:
[h3]What is this madness??[/h3]

Super Mombo Quest is a game about a wacky purple monster who is somehow destined to save the world of Subrosa. That monster is you, of course! 

You'll have boatloads of fun wreaking havoc on the land, [b]madly stomping about and destroying everything you touch[/b] - while the Guardians will do their best to try and put you on the path to defeat the EVIL King of Nightmares.


[h3]What is the game about?[/h3]

Crazy acrobatics! Combo mechanics! Precision platforming! Super Mombo Quest is all about mastering the movement and madly bouncing and stomping your way through each level.

Once you get good enough at controlling our mad purple hero, you'll be flying through levels, grabbing all the collectibles and [b]defeating all the enemies in a smooth, flawless dance of chaos and destruction[/b]. 


[h3]Where do I sign up?[/h3]

Glad you asked! All you need to do is visit our game's page and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262040/Super_Mombo_Quest]play the demo[/url] yourself! If you want to know more, make sure to tune in to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1262040/partnerevents/preview/2235420903978223667]Gameplay + Q&A Live Stream[/url] on Tuesday, June 9 as well. 

Oh, and if you'd like, you can[url=https://discord.gg/ZTJ5VxM] join our discord server[/url] too, where you can talk directly to us, and to other people who are following the game! We'll spend the entire afternoon of Tuesday, June 11 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1262040/partnerevents/2235420903975256486]talking to you all and answering our questions there[/url]!

Last but not least, feel free to leave a comment down below! We will make sure to check those and [b]we'll be answering your comments down here every day[/b]. Last but not least, leave a like on the page if you want to help other players find the game :D

[h3]Thanks! [/h3]

notes.title: FIVE HOURS of talking to developers!
notes.content:
[h3]We want to meet you![/h3]

Played our demo and wants to tell us what you thought? Curious about our development schedule? Wanna talk with some cool people making even cooler stuff? We've got you covered!

Join us on [b]Thursday, June 18[/b], where we'll spend the entire afternoon answering each and every one of your questions, suggestions, comments or ideas! We love talking to players, and it'd be wonderful to hear everyone's thoughts!

The chat will take place [url=https://discord.gg/ZTJ5VxM]in our discord channel[/url], which is where us developers hang out with playtesters and other people interested in our game's development. [b]That's where we run the closed beta[/b], by the way!

[h3]Can't wait to get in touch?[/h3]

No biggie! You can leave your ideas, suggestions, opinions and more in the comment section here as well! We'll be checking it out daily, and [b]we'll answer your comments down below every day[/b], so you can rest assure your feedback won't be missed! 

You can always [url=https://discord.gg/ZTJ5VxM]join our discord[/url] sooner, too! We won't be as responsive as during the event, but we're often online, and you can talk to [b]over 300 players[/b] who are following our game as well!

Last but not least, remember to [b]leave a like on this page[/b] if you'd like to help others find it. Showing the game to a friend goes a long way towards helping us as well!

[h3]See you on Thursday, June 18![/h3]
Set a reminder so you don't miss it :D

notes.title: GET READY for our Gameplay + Q&A Live Stream!!
notes.content:
[h3]Watch our level designer play![/h3]

In this event, you'll watch Werneck - one of the level designers in Super Mombo Quest - play through the Demo, talking about our thought process for each and every area, as well as the design of the game itself. Later, he'll show you some [b]exclusive areas that are not included in the demo[/b]!


[h3]Ask whatever you want![/h3]

If you have any questions about the game, our studio or development in general, this is the perfect time to ask, and [b]learn more straight from one of the developers[/b], in real time! If you can't make it to the stream, you can always [url=https://discord.gg/ZTJ5VxM]join our discord[/url], and catch us there as well!


[h3]Talk to us in advance![/h3]

Leave a comment if there's anything specific you'd like to see in the stream! Or just say whatever you want, really. [b]We'll be monitoring it and answering comments every day![/b]


If you haven't played Super Mombo Quest yet, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262040/Super_Mombo_Quest/]download the demo here[/url]. Oh, and please leave a like on the page if you want to help more people find it! Sharing also helps us immensely. Thanks!



[h3]See you on Tuesday, June 16![/h3]
Set a reminder so you don't miss it :D
